vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: tickerdb
Version: 0.1.94

The TickerDB skill bundle provides a comprehensive interface for an AI agent to interact with market data services. It includes well-defined instructions for account setup, authentication via API keys, and various market analysis tasks such as watchlist management and scheduled reporting using OpenClaw's native cron functionality. The behavior is entirely consistent with its stated purpose as a financial data tool, and no indicators of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or unauthorized execution were found in SKILL.md or _meta.json.

llm.summary: The skill's requirements and runtime instructions are consistent with a market-data integration: it only asks for a TickerDB API key and uses the TickerDB API to fetch categorical market data.

dimensions.detail: Name/description claim pre-computed market data; the skill only requests a single TICKERDB_KEY and calls the tickerdb API endpoints described in SKILL.md. Nothing requested is unrelated to providing market context.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are focused on onboarding (collect email, verify 6-digit code, obtain apiKey) and then calling summary/watchlist endpoints per ticker. The agent will transmit the user's email and verification code to api.tickerdb.com as part of authentication — this is expected for account creation/login and is documented in the SKILL.md.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or code files are present (instruction-only). Nothing is downloaded or written to disk by the skill itself, minimizing install-time risk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only one environment variable (TICKERDB_KEY) is required and declared as the primary credential. That matches the service's Bearer-token authentication described in the instructions.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill is user-invocable. SKILL.md notes the platform will persist the API key if the user consents — this is reasonable but worth user attention. The skill does not request elevated system-level privileges or modify other skills.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to be what it claims: a TickerDB API integration. Before installing: 1) Confirm you trust https://tickerdb.com and its API policy. 2) Be aware the skill will ask for your email and a verification code and may offer to store the returned API key in the platform — only allow persistence if you want the agent to reuse the key. 3) Prefer creating a dedicated, least-privilege API key on TickerDB if available (so you don't expose broader credentials). 4) If you don't want the interactive onboarding, you can set TICKERDB_KEY yourself in the agent environment instead of entering credentials via chat. 5) Review TickerDB's privacy/terms if handling sensitive account data.
